questions.q: You sleep in a ____ when you go camping.
questions.why: A tent is a small cloth house.

questions.q: Do you like history? Go see the ____ of an old city.
questions.why: Ruins are what is left of old buildings.

questions.q: Traveling with a ____ is the best way to stay safe on a photo safari.
questions.why: A guide shows you the way.

questions.q: A resort is a good place to ____.
Buy a ____ for an exciting ride.
questions.why: You need a ticket for a ride.

questions.q: They can see ____ on a photo safari.
If I ____ near a beach, I would go swimming every day.
If we went on a photo safari, I ____ pictures of lions.
I'd go mountain climbing if I ____ afraid of heights.
questions.why: With be: were / weren't for everyone.

questions.q: If we took some good photos, we ____ them on the internet.
He ____ go to the beach if he had homework.
I would visit the ruins if I ____ to Egypt.
When you travel to another country, you need a ____.
questions.why: A passport shows who you are.

questions.q: If we arrived at the ____ late, we would miss our plane.
I always buy ____ on vacation to remember the fun I had.
My mom wears ____ when it's sunny outside.
My brother has a ____ with wheels to make it easy to carry.
questions.why: A suitcase is a big travel bag.

questions.q: I would rather go on an ecotour ____ go to a theme park.
Would you rather go on a trip ____ stay home?
He'd rather ____ eat at that restaurant.
She'd rather eat breakfast than ____ to school hungry.
questions.why: After than, use the base verb.

questions.q: Let's go to a theme park. I don't feel like it. I'd ____ go hiking.
The Unit 8 song is called ____.
questions.why: The song is If I Went on Vacation.

questions.q: Which word rhymes with "shower"?
questions.why: flower and shower both end like "our".

questions.q: Which word rhymes with "more"?
questions.why: floor and more sound the same at the end.

questions.q: The tree houses in India are ____ meters in the air.
In India, the elevator is made of ____.
questions.why: It's a bamboo elevator powered by water.

questions.q: In Peru, the tree houses are in the Amazon ____.
questions.why: They are near the Yarapa River.

questions.q: The Forbidden City was built for ____.
questions.why: It was the home of 24 emperors.

questions.q: The Forbidden City opened as a museum in ____.
questions.why: In 1987 it became a World Heritage Site.

questions.q: Joseph Lekuton says the best teachers are education and ____.
A respectful tourist ____.
A travel review helps other people ____.
options: decide if they want the same trip

questions.q: Which is a question you could start a review with?
questions.why: Starting with a question makes it interesting.
